dataset: NASA MGS MOLA Precision Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Grayscale Mosaic
elevation_encoding: IEEE Float32 elevation in meters relative to Mars MOLA Datum

grayscale_convention.black: Minimum elevation (-8,201 m, Hellas Planitia floor)
grayscale_convention.medium_gray: Martian Datum and intermediate plateaus (0 m to +8,000 m)
grayscale_convention.white: Highest volcanic peaks (21,241 m, Olympus Mons summit caldera)

tile_coverage: 72 tiles (6 rows x 12 cols, 30° x 30° each)
